paper_title: Audio-Visual Efficient Conformer for Robust Speech Recognition
caption: Audio-only back-end modules FLOPs (Billion).
model_annotation: The bar chart illustrates the computational cost, measured in Giga FLOPs, of different audio-only back-end modules across three stages of a model, with each stage representing a different configuration of model dimensions (d) and number of layers (n). The x-axis is labeled "Audio back-end Conformer Stage" and displays three distinct stages: Stage 1 (d=180, n=500), Stage 2 (d=256, n=250), and Stage 3 (d=360, n=125). The y-axis, labeled "Module Giga FLOPs," ranges from 0 to 0.3. For each stage, four different module types are compared: "attention" (blue), "grouped attention (g=3)" (red), "patch attention (k=3)" (yellow), and "feed-forward" (green). In Stage 1, the "attention" module has the highest FLOPs at approximately 0.28, followed by "grouped attention" at ~0.17, "patch attention" at ~0.13, and "feed-forward" at ~0.14. In Stage 2, the "attention" module again has the highest FLOPs at ~0.17, followed by "grouped attention" at ~0.13, "patch attention" at ~0.11, and "feed-forward" at ~0.14. In Stage 3, the "attention" module has FLOPs of ~0.13, "grouped attention" at ~0.11, "patch attention" at ~0.10, and "feed-forward" at ~0.14. The legend at the top left identifies the color coding for each module type.
